newsitem.title: USA: Nike says knows of no new Buffett interest.
newsitem.headline: Nike says knows of no new Buffett interest.

text.p: Nike Inc spokesman Rick Anguilla said the sportswear company knows of no evidence behind speculation in the market that investor Warren Buffett likes the stock as an investment or is planning to buy shares.

Class B shares of Nike surged on Wednesday on such speculation. The stock was up 3-3/8 to 63-3/8 in afternoon trading with more than 3.9 million shares traded. Earlier, it had risen as high as 66-1/2.
"This is just a bit out of the blue," Anguilla told Reuters. "We know of no new interest."
Buffett is chairman of Berkshire Hathaway Inc. Its GEICO insurance unit owns a stake of just under five million shares, according to Anguilla, which it bought about two years ago.
Berkshire shares slipped slightly, down $100 to $42,900 each.
